title: Captions app promo: raw footage -> styled captioned edit in one tap
summary: A 15 s app ad with VO: on a soft pastel gradient (pink-cream top, sky-blue edges), a raw selfie clip card sits beside its tilted 'After' twin with a cursor clicking 'Generate edit' and the captioned version appearing; then a phone in hand scrolls a grid of 100+ caption styles; floating glass status pills stack ('Captions added / B-roll applied / Adding music / Done!') over a lifestyle phone shot; a row of four vertical cards shows four distinct caption styles side by side; logo end card with App Store badge.
fit_reason: Strong reference for both the 'before/after' product demo and a catalogue of caption styles; the light pastel canvas + glass status pills read premium SaaS, though the lifestyle B-roll is consumer.

palette.mood: light airy pastel gradient (blush pink/cream to sky blue) around full-colour footage

typography.display: rounded geometric sans lowercase wordmark ('captions' with blob icon); UI labels in SF Pro
typography.size_behaviour: small UI-scale labels; big centred wordmark only on end card
typography.notes: The video doubles as a caption-style catalogue: see captions field for the exact styles shown.

text_animation: wordmark letters reveal left-to-right over the cards ('ca..ti..' mid-reveal at 3 s)
status pills slide up and stack, each new pill pushes older ones up and blurs/fades them (glass morphism)
end-card App Store badge + URL fade in under logo
captions: Showcased styles (inside the vertical clips): (1) 'After' clip: elegant serif italic, white, lower-left third, phrase-level ('I had to learn', 'close my laptop', 'get out of the house'), no box, soft shadow; (2) beige highlight box #E5D7B0 with black serif italic text, lower third, phrase ('or store'); (3) small white sans line above a huge 2-line heavy condensed italic keyword in cyan #1DC9CB ('about me is I actually' / 'FULL SERVICE') = keyword-pop style, centred mid-frame; (4) bold upper sans in red-orange #CE361E with black outline, single word, centre ('FOLLOW-UP'); (5) plain white serif lowercase, small, centre-right ('hold this'). Phrase-level timing (2-4 words) in most; keyword-pop on emphasis words. The ad itself has no burned-in captions for its own VO.
motion: cursor click on 'Generate edit' button triggers the After card
After card tilted ~8 degrees with a glowing cyan scan outline that traces the frame as it 'processes'
hand-held phone scroll through style grid (live action)
slow push-in on phone on desk
four cards slide in from the right, staggered
transitions: hard cuts between scenes on VO phrases
graphic_elements: rounded video cards with drop shadow
glass status pills with icons (CC, B-roll, music, check)
ui_treatment: mix of rebuilt minimal UI (buttons, pills, cards) on gradient and live-action phone-in-hand shots of the real app

sound.music: light upbeat bed, quiet master (-26 LUFS)
sound.voiceover: yes, friendly female/neutral VO: 'Turn your raw footage into a fully edited video in one tap... Choose from 100+ viral styles... grow your brand, not your editing time.'
sound.sync: each scene cut lands on a VO phrase; status pills timed to 'build a custom edit'

signature_moves: before card + tilted after card with glowing scan outline
glass status pills stacking ('Captions added / B-roll applied / Adding music / Done!')
four-up row of vertical clips each in a different caption style

best_segments.what: Generate edit click -> tilted After card with cyan scan outline and serif italic captions appearing
glass status pills stack up over phone footage and resolve to 'Done!'
four vertical clips each showing a different caption style, then logo end card

recreate.how: Remotion/HTML: pastel linear-gradient bg, video cards with border-radius and box-shadow, rotate(8deg) After card with SVG stroke-dashoffset scan outline; glass pills = backdrop-filter blur + white 40% bg, translateY stack; caption style presets as React components. For Andrew: before/after of his raw clip vs captioned edit.
recreate.prompt: Soft blush-to-sky pastel gradient, a raw vertical selfie clip next to a tilted 'After' version whose border traces with a glowing cyan line as captions appear, glass status pills stacking 'Captions added', 'B-roll applied', 'Adding music', 'Done!', then four vertical clips side by side in four caption styles.
